1.name: Ether Crystal
1.flavor: The effect of this magical artifact is yet to be discovered.
1.helpText:
Note that this card cannot be destroyed. This is not considered an effect, since there is no effect icon next to it. So, crossing out an effect would not make it possible either. Like you would ever want to...
NOTE: Since the card cannot be destroyed, it cannot be selected in a purge.

description:
This is a card made accessible by the Mysterious Cave. It's mysterious, and magical. But you don't know what to do with it... One thing is for sure though: it must be kept separate from the everyday life of your kingdom!
Since it cannot be destroyed, it cannot be selected in a purge.
